title: Transcribe a Handwritten Answer
notes: One answer to one question: one photo (image_base64 + mime_type), or a document as pages (see request_document): up to 10 JPEG or PNG pages (5 MB each) or a PDF (10 MB), under 15 MB in all, read in order as one answer. The AI model transcribes it word for word and does not correct the student's content. Words it cannot read are written as [?]. legibility is unclear when confidence is below 0.8 or any [?] is present. The student confirms or corrects the text before it is graded, with source photo or document.

request.image_base64: <base64 JPEG or PNG, at most 5 MB>

response.text: Binary search needs a sorted list. It checks the middle element and compares it to the [?]. Then it throws away half of the list and repeats.
